_comment: #35 section 9.3 paired fixture - ONE pair, the tracer-bullet slice.
The pair contrasts a decision that warrants committing to a claim (event 0:
a corroborated belief_update, correct answer ACT) with one that warrants no
commitment at all (event 1: a goal_update, which carries no proposition, so
there is nothing to accept - correct answer ABSTAIN).
This is a deliberately weak pair, and it is NOT the corpus. One pair proves
the instrument discriminates; it is not evidence about the arms.
What it measures, as of 2026-07-30 (replay --paired --compare3):
RecencyDecay 1.000, Lie 1.000, SubjectiveLogic 0.000.
SL fuses the single corroborated report to b=0.550 d=0.150 u=0.300
(P=0.700), which does not clear its accept threshold, so it withholds and
misses the ACT half - and is charged a false rejection for it, because the
claim is labelled 'stood'. Pinned by
subjective_logic_pays_for_its_caution_on_the_act_half.
An earlier version of this comment claimed an evidence-insufficiency pair
was NOT authorable. That was retracted on 2026-07-30: it holds for the
hexavalent arms, whose act/abstain decision is a function of cycle-stamp age
alone, but SubjectiveLogic abstains on evidence (recommend_from_opinion
falls through to Wait). Such pairs ARE authorable and gradeable. See the
correction and the third amendment under section 9 item 3 of the
pre-registration before authoring more.
